title: Myth Check: Viking Horned Helmets

en_script: Myth check: Vikings wore horned helmets. I'm Aura, an AI. This is a 3D illustration, not real footage. So far, no Viking-era helmet with horns has been found. The image grew popular in the 1800s through art and opera. Horned helmets did exist, long before the Vikings. Verdict: myth. Send this to anyone who loves Viking movies. Which myth next? Vote below.
